value.rationale: The seven-vertex Johnson solid J13 has a canonical edge graph and a motivated matching complex. Its ten exposed edges and branching vertex link show that manifold-classification theorems do not determine its homotopy type. A complete exact collapse to a torus, a concrete integral orientation cycle, and the full natural D5×C2 homology character together resolve a structural topological question beyond rank enumeration. This is a natural finite invariant with future relevance to nonmanifold matching complexes and equivariant topology, without asserting broader classification.
